name: The Legend of GEML: Awakening
author: Robby Zampino, Ethan Hunter
description: A Zelda-inspired top-down adventure: explore a world of rocks, rivers and floor switches and find your way forward. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

descriptions.en: A Zelda-inspired top-down adventure: explore a world of rocks, rivers and floor switches and find your way forward. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.
descriptions.it: Un'avventura vista dall'alto ispirata a Zelda: esplora un mondo di rocce, fiumi e interruttori a pavimento e trova la strada. Creata per la prima game jam di WASM-4.
